issues.failure_explanation: Take $\vec v_h$ to be one local nodal basis function $\phi_{j,K}$. By definition $m_{j,K}=\int_K\phi_{j,K}$, so $\|\phi_{j,K}\|_h^2=\int_K\phi_{j,K}$ while $\|\phi_{j,K}\|_{L^2}^2=\int_K\phi_{j,K}^2$. On an affine quadrilateral cell these are $|K|/4$ and $|K|/9$, hence $|\|v_h\|_h-\|v_h\|_{L^2}|/\|v_h\|_{L^2}=1/2$ for every mesh size. The asserted bound with $C h^s\to0$ is therefore impossible: mass lumping gives only two-sided norm equivalence with mesh-independent constants, not relative $\mathcal O(h^s)$ agreement uniformly over the finite element space.

diagnostic_evidence.quote: This can be achieved via an artificial relaxation approach by lowering the

issues.failure_explanation: The rescaling factor $\{1-\max(0,\delta\mathcal E^{n+1}/\mathcal E^{n+1}_{\rm kin})\}^{1/2}$ is the square root of a negative number whenever $\delta\mathcal E^{n+1}\ge\mathcal E^{n+1}_{\rm kin}$, and the quotient is undefined when $\mathcal E^{n+1}_{\rm kin}=0$; the step is then not executable. Moreover only $\vec m^{n+1}$ is rescaled while the total energy $\mathcal E^{n+1}$ is left untouched, so the discrete total energy changes by exactly $\delta\mathcal E^{n+1}$ (the field-energy jump) and the advertised restoration of a discrete energy balance does not follow.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Cap the relaxation factor, e.g. $\{\max(0,1-\delta\mathcal E^{n+1}/\mathcal E^{n+1}_{\rm kin})\}^{1/2}$, treat the $\mathcal E^{n+1}_{\rm kin}=0$ case separately, and update the total energy consistently, $\mathcal E^{n+1}\leftarrow\inte^n+\tfrac12\rho^n|\vec v^{n+1}|^2$, after the momentum rescaling.
issues.overall_effect: The restart/relaxation postprocessing is undefined on part of its input range and does not deliver the discrete energy balance promised in the surrounding text, so the structure-preservation claim for the full scheme is not established once a Gauss-law restart is performed.
issues.title: Gauss-law restart with relaxation is undefined in degenerate cases and does not restore the energy balance
